scenes.headline: How a month of post-training alone upgraded GLM-5.2
scenes.sub: Same base weights, synthesized environments, verified rewards, and a cyber surprise.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Rill! GLM-5.3 runs on exactly the same base model as GLM-5.2. Here's where its gains came from instead.

scenes.text: The architecture didn't change. Every gain came from a month of post-training on environments synthesized from real work, with rewards checked first.
scenes.say: The idea: the architecture didn't change at all. Every gain came from post-training, on environments synthesized from real work.

steps.say: Research agents take task patterns from real work and build runnable environments: many steps, hidden state, some worth days of an engineer's time.
A judge agent attempts each task, to confirm it can actually be solved.
A verifier is written without the reference solution. It must accept a correct answer, reject doing nothing, and not already be satisfied at the start.
Pass all three, and its binary reward trains the same base model. Humans are still in the loop.

scenes.label: Terminal-Bench 3.0, GLM-5.2 to GLM-5.3, from post-training alone
scenes.note: 4.6 is near the floor: from not playing to playing
scenes.say: The biggest jump: Terminal-Bench, from four point six to twenty-eight point three. The old score was near the floor.

scenes.label: Z.ai Code Bench at ~75K tokens per task; GLM-5.2: 23.4% at 96K
scenes.note: more accurate and cheaper; the benchmark is private
scenes.say: The better result is efficiency. At max effort it scores thirty-four and a half percent, spending fewer tokens than GLM-5.2 did for twenty-three point four.

scenes.title: Finding flaws is not chaining them

left.title: Finding flaws
left.say: At finding vulnerabilities it leads: eighty-four point five on CyberGym, just ahead of the closed models.

right.title: Chaining exploits
right.say: One rung up, it trails. Given six hours for full chains, it clears a hundred and thirty problems. The leaders clear two hundred forty-seven and two hundred ninety-three.

scenes.text: With the base held fixed, the interesting variable is the environment pipeline, not the model.

recap: Same base model; every gain is post-training
Agents build environments; verifiers are checked three ways
Top at finding flaws, behind at chaining them
scenes.say: To recap: a fixed base, environments built and checked by agents, and a cyber skill that finds more than it chains.
